mechanism: Leflunomide may inhibit CYP1A2 and CYP2C9, potentially affecting levodopa metabolism and increasing CNS stimulation risk; carbidopa-levodopa may also potentiate immunosuppression effects of leflunomide.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa adverse effects (dyskinesias, psychosis, hypertension) and consider levodopa dose adjustment if needed; ensure adequate disease activity monitoring with leflunomide.
